svg.title: AWS DevOps workshop labs: starter, solution and offline grader
svg.desc: Five labs each ship a starter, a solution and a grader. A participant runs make check on the untouched starter and sees six FAIL lines and exit 1; after editing the starter every objective shows PASS and the grader exits 0. The CI verify job grades every lab with no cloud credentials: each solution exits 0, each starter exits 1, and all five labs are ok.
svg.text: AWS DEVOPS WORKSHOP LABS · OFFLINE GRADING
